name: Gearbox
text: Choose the latest NVIDIA H100 PCIe GPU for EXCAVA’s compute node. It delivers a 15–20% uplift over the A100 in matrix math, which directly boosts EXCAVA’s core excavation speed. The trade-off is a 3× higher power draw and a $30k price tag, but the net gain in excavation throughput outweighs the cost.

name: Torque
text: The H100’s raw math speed hides a hidden cost: memory bandwidth. EXCAVA’s excavation isn’t just matrix math—it’s memory-bound when streaming large excavation grids. A dual-GPU setup with AMD Instinct MI325X (higher HBM capacity, lower idle power) could net 8–12% uplift with half the power draw and 1/5 the cost. Benchmark both against EXCAVA’s real workloads—if the MI325X trails by <2%, it’s the smarter play.
